text:
maria_fin: Heads up — invoice INV-3005 ($48,000) failed to charge the card on file (pm_1JHxxx, card last4 4242). Stripe returned `card_declined`. Customer is on annual committed plan; renewal was charged today. Should we attempt an immediate retry or reach out for wire/ACH? :thinking:

jaxon_billing: Can we see the decline reason code? Sometimes it's temporary. If it's soft_decline we can retry after a couple hours. If it's fraud or insufficient_funds we need customer action.

payments-bot: Autopay attempts: 2024-05-10T13:02:41Z (failed: card_declined), 2024-05-10T13:12:43Z (failed: card_declined). Retry schedule exhausted (2 attempts). See `evt_1KX...` in Stripe logs.

maria_fin: Thanks. Stripe reason is `card_declined` (generic). No AVS mismatch flagged. Gateway notes: "issuer_decline".

sophie_cs: I'm on it — I just pinged the customer (acct: redwood-corp). Asked if they'd like to provide wire instructions or set up ACH. Also offered a temporary hold on usage if they want to avoid service interruption.

tom_sales: Customer told me they need wire instructions — finance on their side requires them for large transfers. I sent a redacted template, asked for remittance email. We should not post full wire details here; can ops_ach DM them the secure doc. :lock: 

ops_ach: I can handle ACH setup. If they prefer ACH (Plaid or micro-deposits) we need the ACH authorization form and 2 micro-deposits to verify. For wire we do: send secure S3 link with wire instructions + invoice copy. Ping me the contact.

jaxon_billing: Proposed action: 1) Hold retry until we hear back from customer (to avoid more declines), 2) Offer wire with net3 terms, 3) If they want ACH, kick off Plaid link flow. We should also log a collection case in Zendesk.

maria_fin: Agreed. I've created internal collection ticket CHG-887 and set status "awaiting customer payment method". Sophie, can you confirm remittance contact and if they'll go wire vs ACH?

sophie_cs: Confirmed remit contact: emily@redwood-corp.com. They prefer wire. Emily asked for the beneficiary name and our bank address, and whether we can accept partial payment to avoid service cutoff.

maria_fin: Reply to Emily: we can accept partial wire to keep services active; please include invoice INV-3005 on the remittance. I'll DM full bank details to Ops for secure delivery. Also adding a 5 business-day grace before suspension.

payments-bot: Note — if customer later wants to switch to ACH, use the /payments start-ach flow which sends Plaid link, verification takes ~1-2 business days.

tom_sales: FYI sales is ok with partial payment. Please CC me on remittance confirmation so I can track renewal.

maria_fin: Done. DMing ops_ach now with the secure wire doc. Marking thread solved for finance until we get confirmation from Emily. :white_check_mark:
